[EN] Preserved Meat
[ES] Carne en conserva
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Use the salt on the meat to cure it.
[ES] Usa la sal en la carne para curarla.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Now we've plenty to eat, and plenty to put up for later.
[ES] Ahora tenemos suficiente para comer y guardar para más tarde.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to Centurion Verus at the Woodcutter Palisade.
[ES] Ve con el centurión Verus en Woodcutter Palisade.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "For the federation!"
[ES] "¡Por la federación!"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Use the barrel and salt to cure the meat.
[ES] Usa el barril y la sal para curar la carne.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver the salted meat to Einna.
[ES] Entrega la carne salada a Einna.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
